rubric.role_summary: Remote U.S. analyst role supporting ultra-high-net-worth advisory clients through investment performance reporting, data integrity, transaction reporting, and portfolio data management, including private equity and alternative investments.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Remote U.S. analyst role supporting ultra-high-net-worth advisory clients through investment performance reporting, data integrity, transaction reporting, and portfolio data management, including private equity and alternative investments.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Bachelor’s degree.
- 3 years of experience in financial services.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Background in performance reporting software.
- Located in the Pacific or Mountain time zone.
- Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Accept any one of these geographic alternatives (OR): United States. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them. Remote candidates must currently be located in one of these areas; remote work does not remove this geographic condition.
